snippet.title: Harvesters Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
A short incremental game about gathering resources in different planets. 
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982600/Harvesters/
or
Sign up for closed playtests here: https://cutt.ly/JyhgYqeq


Upgrade the harvesters, unlock new buildings, and unlock new ways to gather resources!
It's all about watching lil people do their thing.
